items.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: in 1936 you recorded with Billie Holiday.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. But those were all — I could go on for nine days with the war experiences.
Let me ask you about a couple of recordings. And if my information is correct, in 1936 you recorded with Billie Holiday.
Yeah. “Billie’s Blues,” “Summertime,” and, yeah, that became a classic 78.
